user.title: GWM Jolion
user.description: Alpha version. Enter the credentials used by the Russian GWM app. A vehicle security PIN is required for remote commands.

reauth.title: GWM Jolion — reauthentication
reauth.description: Enter the password for the GWM account.

init.title: GWM Jolion settings
init.description: PIN: {pin_status}. Experimental buttons are disabled by default in the entity registry.

start_engine.name: Start engine
start_engine.description: Starts the engine remotely through GWM Cloud.

stop_engine.name: Stop engine
stop_engine.description: Stops an engine that was started remotely.

flash_lights.name: Flash lights
flash_lights.description: Uses the vehicle lights for remote vehicle search.

flash_and_horn.name: Flash lights and sound horn
flash_and_horn.description: Flashes the lights and sounds the horn together.

unlock_vehicle.name: Unlock vehicle
unlock_vehicle.description: Unlocks the central locking system remotely.

lock_vehicle.name: Lock vehicle
lock_vehicle.description: Locks the central locking system remotely.

close_windows.name: Close windows
close_windows.description: Sends the command to close all windows.

cabin_clean.name: Ventilate cabin for 60 seconds (experimental)
cabin_clean.description: Experimental Cabin Clean / cabin ventilation command.
